context.package.json:
{
  "name": "@primer/agent-eval-workspace",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "turbo run build",
    "changeset": "changeset",
    "format": "prettier --cache --write '**/*.{js,css,md,mdx,ts,tsx,yml}'",
    "format:diff": "prettier --cache --list-different '**/*.{js,css,md,mdx,ts,tsx,yml}'",
    "lint": "eslint '**/*.{js,ts,tsx}' --max-warnings=0 --cache",
    "release": "pnpm --filter @primer/agent-eval run build && changeset publish",
    "test": "vitest",
    "type-check": "tsc --noEmit"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@changesets/cli": "^2.31.1",
    "@eslint/js": "10.0.1",
    "@github/prettier-config": "^0.0.6",
    "@primer/agent-eval": "workspace:*",
    "@types/node": "^26.0.1",
    "eslint": "^10.7.0",
    "eslint-plugin-github": "^6.1.1",
    "globals": "^17.6.0",
    "prettier": "^3.8.3",
    "rolldown": "^1.1.5",
    "turbo": "^2.10.5",
    "typescript": "^6.0.3",
    "typescript-eslint": "^8.62.0",
    "vitest": "^4.1.8"
  },
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.17.0+sha512.cca3cea332ad254bb84145f966d19f4879615210346fc92c79a047f23a0d7b3cca3c3792f0076ba1f1831d277efbcf0a9119b31a9a60eca7fb3d6231f331ef72"
}
context.pnpm-workspace.yaml:
allowBuilds:
  cpu-features: true
  protobufjs: true
  sharp: true
  ssh2: true

minimumReleaseAge: 10080

packages:
  - 'scenarios/*'
  - 'experiments'
  - 'packages/*'
  - 'website'
context.scenarios/000-nextjs-template/tsconfig.j:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2017",
    "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"],
    "allowJs": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "strict": false,
    "noEmit": true,
    "incremental": true,
    "module": "esnext",
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "next"
      }
    ]
  },
  "include": ["next-env.d.ts", ".next/types/**/*.ts", ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts", "**/*.mts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules"]
}
context.scenarios/000-vite-template/tsconfig.jso:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "useDefineForClassFields": true,
    "lib": ["ES2022", "DOM", "DOM.Iterable"],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "allowImportingTsExtensions": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "moduleDetection": "force",
    "noEmit": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "strict": true,
    "types": ["vite/client"]
  },
  "include": ["src"]
}

context.tsconfig.base.json:
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ESNext",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "lib": ["ESNext", "ESNext.Disposable"],
    "allowJs": true,
    "checkJs": false,
    "jsx": "preserve",
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "strict": true,
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "types": ["node"],
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "moduleDetection": "force",
    "erasableSyntaxOnly": true,
    "verbatimModuleSyntax": true
  },
}
